a.title: Job posting seemingly confirms Apple is working on its own AI agent for coding and other tasks

b.lede: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg, which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant. […]
b.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
